desc: Exhibit in the Nelson-Atkins Museum of Art, Kansas City, Missouri. This artwork is old enough so that it is in the public domain, and the museum permitted photography without restriction. I took this photograph and release it into the public domain.

title: File:Meissen Porcelain Manufactory - Allegory of Sight - Walters 48930.jpg
desc:
"The Allegory of Sight" is originally from a series of statuettes representing the personification of the five senses.
These statuettes exhibit the masterly sculptural quality of Meissen porcelain between 1733 and 1775 when J. J. Kändler served as a chief modeler.
